title: Diffusion Flow Matching: Dimension-Improved KL Bounds and Wasserstein Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2606.16610v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion Flow Matching (DFM) has recently emerged as a versatile framework for generative modeling, yet its theoretical convergence properties remain only partially understood. In this work, we provide refined and novel convergence guarantees for Brownian motion based DFMs, focusing on the discretization error. Our analysis is conducted under the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence and the 2-Wasserstein distance. Under finite-moment conditions and a mild score integrability assumption, we derive KL convergence bounds with improved dimensional dependence compared to prior work, achieving, up to our knowledge, state-of-the-art scaling under minimal conditions. We further extend the analysis to the 2-Wasserstein distance: under an additional first-order score integrability assumption and a weak log-concavity condition, we obtain convergence guarantees with dimensional dependence consistent with the KL case.

translated_title: 扩散流匹配：维度改进的KL界与Wasserstein保证
translated_abstract: 扩散流匹配（DFM）近来已成为一种用途广泛的生成建模框架，但其理论收敛性质仍未被完全理解。在本工作中，我们为基于布朗运动的DFM提供了精细且新颖的收敛保证，重点关注离散化误差。我们的分析在Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度和2-Wasserstein距离下进行。在有限矩条件和温和的得分（score）可积性假设下，我们推导出了相比先前工作具有更优维度依赖性的KL收敛界，据我们所知，在最少的条件下达到了最先进的收敛标度。我们进一步将分析扩展到2-Wasserstein距离：在额外的一阶得分可积性假设和弱对数凹性条件下，我们获得了与KL情形维度依赖性一致的收敛保证。
tldr: 本文为基于布朗运动的扩散流匹配提供了在KL散度和2-Wasserstein距离下具有更优维度依赖性的离散化误差收敛保证，在温和条件下达到了最先进的收敛标度。
en_tdlr: This paper provides refined discretization error convergence guarantees for Brownian motion-based Diffusion Flow Matching under KL divergence and 2-Wasserstein distance, achieving state-of-the-art dimensional scaling under minimal conditions.
